5147-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.

Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

1753-2023-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1879-2023-3755-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4316-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

512-5475-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-5475-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5475-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

3330-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
3330-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

654-728-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-728-2577-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5268-6255--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5268-6255--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-6495-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-6495-7422.description:
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.
586-864-3125-6495-7422.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1303-1769-1982.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Sidisi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sidisi enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, sacrificing it.
When Sidisi exploits itself, its third ability triggers, causing you to search your library for a card and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Sidisi.
When the token Sidisi enters, it triggers, sacrificing Rot Hulk.
When Sidisi exploits Rot Hulk, its third ability triggers, causing you to search your library for a card and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-6823-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6823-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2292-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-2292-4302.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4381-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat.

1636-3088-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-3088-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

3175-3967-7424.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

765-3259-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
765-3259-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

252-1575-2292-5776.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
252-1575-2292-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1169-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

483-5170-5256-6132.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2638-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2638-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

104-2741-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2741-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

647-2457-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1251-1305-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

2634-4910-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-4910-5148.description:
Activate Alchemist's Refuge's second ability by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

841-4544-5231--106.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4544-5231--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-4544-5231--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

4231-4508-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

199-2573-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
199-2573-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two other Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard, then play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

859-1496-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
859-1496-4702.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the Lurking Roper token's toughness.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

1235-4705-4719-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Anarchist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Anarchist with haste.
When the Anarchist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

696-2751-4091-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Black Market has at least six charge counters on it.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
696-2751-4091-5200.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Black Market's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Black Market's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Black Market's trigger, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Aphetto Alchemist.
Repeat from step 2.

890-3338-4009-4331.notablePrerequisites:
Palladium Myr does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifacts.
890-3338-4009-4331.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Palladium Myr.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other creature using Mirran Spy.

3232-3530-4050-4763.description:
Cast Grim Initiate by paying {R}.
Grim Initiate enters the battlefield, triggering Obsidian Battle-Axe, attaching it to Grim Initiate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Grim Initiate, adding {R}.
Grim Initiate dies, triggering itself and Koll.
Resolve Grim Initiate's trigger, amassing 1.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Grim Initiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie Army token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat the loop without sacrificing the Zombie Army token.

1082-2232-2766-3304.notablePrerequisites:
A Swamp and a Forest on the battlefield.
An additional Swamp, Forest, and seven creature cards in graveyard.
1082-2232-2766-3304.description:
Activate a Swamp and a Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
Molderhulk enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Dual Nature, and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a Molderhulk token.
Molderhulk and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk to your hand.
Molderhulk leaves the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature and exiling all Molderhulk tokens.
Resolve the token Molderhulk trigger, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a different Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a different Swamp from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing the token Molderhulk, drawing six cards and discarding a Swamp, a Forest, and any third card.
Repeat.

1107-1636-2519-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
1107-1636-2519-2757.description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}, allowing you to draw a card whenever a creature enters the battlefield this turn.
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Llanowar Mentor by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Llanowar Elves creature token.
The Llanowar Elves token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Rite of Harmony.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Rite of Harmony trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Llanowar Elves token, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-4743.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3490-4743.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Blood Aspirant, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

337-776-1329-4786.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-4786.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Claws of Gix to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Claws of Gix.
Cast Claws of Gix.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2615-3432-3587.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
2615-3432-3587.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Star of Extinction for {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to all creatures and planeswalkers.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
